name: rengine
description: A composable desktop workspace for game projects and CLI agents

scripts.test: RENGINE_SUITE_PREBUILT=1 RENGINE_IDE_DIRECTORY=.cache/ide-locks RED_PTY_IDLE_SECONDS=5 RED_STORE_IDLE_SECONDS=5 RED_TOKEN_IDLE_SECONDS=5 node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.build: cargo run --quiet --manifest-path red/Cargo.toml -p red-supervisor --bin red-launch -- build
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build && RENGINE_IDE_DIRECTORY=.cache/ide-locks node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/native.spec.mjs tests/native-game.spec.mjs tests/native-layout.spec.mjs tests/native-handoff.spec.mjs tests/native-terminal-recovery.spec.mjs tests/native-terminal-scroll.spec.mjs tests/native-scrollbars.spec.mjs tests/native-terminal-mouse.spec.mjs tests/native-updates.spec.mjs tests/native-bootstrap.spec.mjs tests/native-project-windows.spec.mjs tests/native-render.spec.mjs tests/native-format-registry.spec.mjs tests/native-format-hardening.spec.mjs tests/native-dashboard.spec.mjs tests/native-devices.spec.mjs tests/native-design.spec.mjs tests/native-settings.spec.mjs tests/native-explorer.spec.mjs tests/native-input-routing.spec.mjs tests/native-identity.spec.mjs tests/native-tracker.spec.mjs tests/native-external-project.spec.mjs tests/native-game-declaration.spec.mjs tests/native-cooperative.spec.mjs tests/native-recording.spec.mjs tests/native-token.spec.mjs tests/native-token-e2e.spec.mjs tests/native-sessions.spec.mjs tests/native-sessions-token.spec.mjs tests/native-stale-sessions.spec.mjs tests/native-ide-selection.spec.mjs tests/native-tasks-controls.spec.mjs tests/native-diagnostics.spec.mjs tests/native-plugin.spec.mjs tests/native-file-images.spec.mjs tests/native-label-clip.spec.mjs tests/native-tracker-virtual.spec.mjs tests/native-open-target.spec.mjs tests/native-scene-tab.spec.mjs tests/native-plugin-render.spec.mjs tests/native-front-door.spec.mjs tests/native-agent-select.spec.mjs tests/native-projects-modal.spec.mjs
scripts.test:game-nolf: npm run build && RENGINE_IDE_DIRECTORY=.cache/ide-locks node --test tests/native-nolf.spec.mjs
